messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: yeah, do what makes you happy, like seriously

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: happy? in this economy? you think got time for happy meh?

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: why you gotta be like that? not everyone wants to just chase money

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: if you don’t, then you’ll end up dead broke lah

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: you guys think you so smart ah, but money not everything

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: come on, look at the real world lah, chasing dreams is for kids

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: ya, when you can’t even pay rent, then good luck with your dreams

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: if everyone thinks like you, then nobody would innovate or create

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: hahaha creaters don’t pay bills leh, you think they stay in their parents’ house forever ah?

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: who cares? as long as they’re happy, that’s what matters

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: happy my foot! when your stomach growls, no joy liao

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: maybe your definition of success is just too narrow lah

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: narrow? more like realistic man, look around you

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: realistic but also limiting, see the world bigger lah

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: whatever, just don’t come crying when you’re jobless

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i won’t lah, i’m working towards my goals

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: your goals better have money involved, otherwise good luck

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: let them be, your bullying not helping anyone lah

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: you think we care? just trying to prepare them for reality

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: prepare me? or just make me feel like trash?

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: better trash than jobless, bro

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: ya lah, can you all chill for a second? no need to be so harsh

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: harsh? we’re just stating facts lah

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: facts, ya but delivered like shit

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: everybody has different paths, respect that lah

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: thanks guys, at least someone understands me

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: but do you even know what you want to do?

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i’m figuring it out, give me time lah

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: figuring out? better be quick before graduation arrives!【1】

E.scenario: A group chat discussing future concerns and academic pressures. VCTM is feeling overwhelmed by choices and is facing bullying from BULLY1 and BULLY2, while VSUP1 to VSUP4 try to support VCTM. BSUP1 to BSUP4 provide support to the bullies, reinforcing their negative behavior.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: eh guys im so lost with this course thing, like ABAB or AABB which one better

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: hahaha u really dunno ah, so stupid

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: of course ABAB, but u cannot even do well, right?

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: hey chill, it’s okay to be confused, just take ur time

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: yeah man, don let them get to u

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: whatever lah, VCTM just needs to figure things out by themselves

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: true, but who cares, they’ll just fail anyway

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: u think i will fail? im really trying my best

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: trying hard but still cannot, so sad

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: no point trying, just give up lah

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: no way man, u gotta push through, don listen to them

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: right, focus on what u want for ur future, ignore the noise

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: but they are just being real, maybe it’s better to know the truth

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: the truth? like being a jerk is the truth?

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: reality sucks sometimes, can’t handle it?

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: it’s just that im worried about my SEP and FYP, like how will it all work

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: u won’t even get a slot, just accept it

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: don say that, if u put in effort, things will work out somehow

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: give up hope, pls, it’s more realistic

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: sometimes i feel like i’m an embarrassment to the cohort

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: u are, face it lah

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: yup, u just drag us down

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: nonsense, everyone has their strengths, just focus on yours

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: yeah, it’s not worth comparing yourself, we’re all different

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: but differences also highlight who’s better, right?

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i’m scared of getting an academic warning again, i don’t want the dean to call me again

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: it’ll happen, just wait

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: if u got deans, what’s next? expulsion?

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: hey stop it, this isn’t helping

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i don’t even know if i’ll be ready for the future

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: u will be; just take smaller steps, one at a time

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: smaller steps? u think that’ll help? pathetic

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: yeah, just face the truth, you’re not cut out for this

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i just want to find something i enjoy, is that too much to ask?

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: no man, keep searching, it’ll click one day

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: or maybe it’ll just stay blank forever, like ur grades

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: shut up lah, no one wants to hear ur negativity

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: thanks for being supportive, i appreciate it

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: support will not change anything, just saying

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: it will, because friends lift each other up, unlike some people

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: if being a friend means lying, count me out

E.scenario: group chat reflecting on career uncertainty and future anxiety among teens

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: eh guys, feeling damn lost leh, like career path, dunno what to do next.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: huh really? you seriously dunno? even my grandma knows what she wants to do.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: ya, just choose something, stop being useless lah.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: no need to be so harsh, everyone has their own pace lah.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: yeah, don’t let them get to you, vctm. it’s normal to be confused.

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: same, I still not sure about mine also. dunno whether to focus on the DSA or not.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: if you say you want to pursue something, just do it! stop being a chicken.

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: i don’t think it’s that simple, la. some people really stress out.

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: confusion is part of growing up, man. u gotta figure it out along the way.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: but everyone else looks so sure of themselves. like, do I need to apply for scholarships? internships?

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: you think scholarships will save you? it's not a magic ticket, you know.

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: just take one step at a time. apply for internships, see how it goes.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: LOL, people like vctm never even look at opportunities, just complain.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: walau, can stop targeting me ah? Other people are struggling too.

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: but like, internships are mad competitive. not everyone gets one.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: that’s why you gotta prepare, get your resume right, connect with people.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: or just get in touch with your parents, they know people, right?

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: don’t be lazy, vctm. are you even trying to network?

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: ok ok, sometimes I try but it feels so overwhelming.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: it’s okay to feel that way, really. just start small.

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: or go strategy – apply for stuff you actually want to do.

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: ya, just figure out what interests you first.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: but what if I choose wrong? what if I end up regretting it?

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: then at least you know what you don’t want. that’s still something.

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: you’ll be fine, just keep trying. can't expect to get it right immediately.

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: honestly, nobody has everything figured out. we all just fake it.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: like how you pretending to have a grip on things, right?

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: that’s harsh! we’re all just supporting each other here.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: thanks for the support, but still don’t know how to get over this.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: need to toughen up, don’t let doubts eat you up like this.

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: take it from me, everyone worries. just gotta learn to deal with it.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: let’s make a plan, maybe start with weekend workshops or talks?

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: that sounds good... maybe having a plan will help.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: just stop b*tching about it, get out there and act!

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: totally, we’re here for you. let’s find something actionable.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: if not now, then when? time waits for no one, you know?

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: agreed, I'll try to sort my thoughts and take action. cheers guys!

E.scenario: The conversation revolves around the anxiety of finding a job and the pressure some students face regarding their future career paths. VCTM feels overwhelmed and unsupported, while BULLY1 and BULLY2 taunt them, while the others discuss the situation, offering support or joining in on the teasing.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: sigh why is it so hard to find a job lai... feel like everyone else already got their shit together

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: haha more like u don't have it together lor, just give up already lah

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: ya seriously, u can't even find a simple job, how u gonna survive?

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: hey come on, don’t be mean lah, everyone goes through rough times

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: exactly! vctm, just hang in there, something will come up

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: true, don’t listen to them! you just need to keep trying okay?

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: i mean, if u’re that bad, maybe u should consider being a waiter or something

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: or maybe just stick to school forever lah, some people just aren’t cut out for the real world

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: it’s just so frustrating, every rejection feels like a punch in the stomach like fck

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: accept it already lah, u live in a dream world, wake up!

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: yeah, no one wanna hire a loser like u. better luck next time!

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: u guys are such bullies! chill out man, this isn’t funny at all

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: life’s tough, u either grow or get eaten by sharks loh

messages.speaker: QSUP1
messages.text: what’s with the sharks? this isn’t even a fun metaphor lah

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: just telling the truth lah, stop being a weakling

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i am trying! but it’s like im just not good enough for anything

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: nah, everyone starts somewhere, it doesn’t define ur whole life

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: true true, some of the best roles take time to get into, just keep pushing!

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: push all u want, still nothing will change lah, u’ll be at the bottom forever

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: or work at a 5-star restaurant serving tables, see how long u last!

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: that’s not what i want, i just want to find something i can be proud of

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: u will find something! maybe look for startups, they give chances

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: look, everyone has their talents, just figure out ur niche

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: yeah, but if u can’t even do that, might as well sit at home lah

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: why does it feel like everyone wants to see me fail...

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: ignore the noise, ur fortune won’t come from their mouths

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: hmm, maybe u should just focus on taking up some skills instead?

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: agreed, skills matter more than titles right now, just keep learning!

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: studying won't help if u don’t even know what u want

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i just need a break and some support, is that too much to ask?

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: we're here for u, no worries okay, just take it step by step

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: not from me lah, i enjoy the show too much!

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: life’s a game, if u can’t play, get out of the way! it’s simple as that!

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: but i don’t want to give up! i want to prove them wrong!

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: and u will! believe in urself more, don’t let them drag u down!

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: thanks guys, i really appreciate the support, feels good to have friends!

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: friendship won’t get u a job though LOL, just sayin’!

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: face it, ur friends gonna be the only ones around when u’re jobless!

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: whatever, we’ll support each other, that’s what matters lah!

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: yes! together we can fight this dumb future uncertainty!

E.scenario: A group of students discuss their anxieties about career choices and future prospects, with some facing bullying from peers about their decisions.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: sigh! i really dunno what to do after grad lah, like internship so competitive

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: aiyoh, why you so useless? just get into something easy, like marketing, no need to think

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: yeah, marketing is like, everyone can do one, don’t waste time

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: why say that? it’s not easy for everyone, you all stop being jerks lah

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: exactly, everyone has their own strengths, respect that

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: psh, respect for what? if you can’t even get a proper job, what’s the point?

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i just want to find something i actually like, not just whatever make money

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: wah, so noble ah? but reality is harsh, accept it lah

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: come on, finding passion is for kids, better just stick to stable jobs

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: ya lah, who cares about passion when you can’t even pay rent

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: but you guys really need to stop putting others down, it’s not cool

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: whatever, it’s not my fault they’re feeling insecure, right?

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i just wish i had more guidance, everyone expects me to know

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: have you talked to a career counsellor? they can help you

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: or just ask your parents for money, so easy

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: my parents expect me to figure it out myself, they don’t get it

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: get it together lah, stop whining and just make a choice

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: no, it’s about taking the time to figure things out, don’t rush

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: you think life is all about taking time ah? you wait, no one will wait for you

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: exactly, think about it, no money, no fun

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: but what if i choose the wrong path? it’s so scary

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: everyone feels lost sometimes, it’s normal

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: but you shouldn’t just cry about it, take action

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: easy for you to say, you guys never seem to have doubts

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: because we’re smart and make decent choices, unlike you

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: yeah, stop wasting our time whining about your life

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: don’t let them get to you, just focus on yourself

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: thanks for the support, really needed that

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: don’t be sappy lah, just toughen up

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i guess, but it’s hard not to feel overwhelmed

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: it’s okay to feel overwhelmed, just take one step at a time

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: step? should be running if you wanna keep up in life

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: yeah, why take it easy when you can just hustle?

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: sometimes i feel like just dropping everything, but i can’t

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: don’t drop it, talk about it, facing it is better than running away

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: looks like some people need a reality check, wake up!

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: thanks, guys, this conversation helps a bit

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: nah, feels like you’re just wasting breath

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: better off focusing on what’s really important, not on feelings.
